Autumn Call Prae Doc
The University of Vienna is advertising 11 PhD positions (call for application opens in September 2026). We look forward to receiving applications from outstanding early-career researchers who wish to complete their PhD at the University of Vienna and actively participate in excellent research within an international environment.
More information on the Autumn Call
SSH Call
At the beginning of 2026, the University of Vienna opened a central call for applications for at least 40 doctoral positions (4 years, 30 hours per week) in the humanities, social sciences, and cultural studies.
This measure was intended to further strengthen the international visibility of the GSK subjects, the quality of the selection process, and the coherence and attractiveness of doctoral training.
More information on the SSH Call
STEM Call
In March 2026 the University of Vienna was seeking outstanding candidates for more than 40 fully funded PhD positions in the Life - and Natural Sciences. We welcomed applications from candidates who wish to pursue a PhD at the University of Vienna and are committed to conducting high-quality research in a thriving research environment.
